quests.title: Sanden's Resource Request

dialogue.sit: Are you the Electro Crystal guy?

dialogue.t: Oh, you must be here about the commission I posted?
Do you have 5 Electro Crystals yet?
Thank you! With this, I can now start making some dyes. Please, take these in exchange for your help.

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Sanden would like to have 5 Electro Crystals.
